Overview

Kostaros is one of the [[doc-ctysttshlns|Helionite city-states]], a coastal polity that governs the surrounding district, including the town of [[doc-myrtillos|Myrtillos]]. To be expanded.

Not to be confused with the Byzarian port town of the same name in the [[doc-byzarianlg|Byzarian League]].
